items.information: ###LV Laipni lūgti pēdējās vasaras sacensībās Latvijā! Izbaudi pēdējās vasaras dienas mierīgā un varbūt kaut nedaudz sācensīgā gaisotnē kopā ar draugiem un ģimeni. **Regulāri pārbaudiet savu epastu un šo sacensību papildus cilnes, lai nepalaistu garām svarīgus atjauninājumus!** ###ENG Welcome to the last summer competition in Latvia! Spend the last days of summer in a relaxed and maybe just a little competitive environment with Your friends and family. **Check the additional tabs of this competition and your email regularly to not miss any important updates!**

items.name: CubingUSA New England Championship 2024
items.information: We are pleased to announce the 2024 CubingUSA New England Championship! This competition is open to all competitors, but only competitors who are residents of Massachusetts, Connecticut, Rhode Island, Vermont, New Hampshire, and Maine are eligible to win the title of New England Champion. ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBc05wIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--4aee0374f9fb1b92497dd4fc2a791aa6ed8e6ab3/nec2024-logo-384x384.png)

items.name: Telangana Cube Championship 2024
items.information: All the participants are expected to volunteer in the competition and every participant (except the New comers) will be assigned to a particular event that they have to Judge (or) Scramble in which they are participating. All the staff/volunteering assignments will be decided by the organising team and participants will be informed of the same 2 days prior to the event, we will ensure that your volunteering does not affect your events. **ALL PARTICIPANTS HAVE TO BE AT THE VENUE ATLEAST 45 MINUTES BEFORE THE START OF THEIR EVENT. LATE COMERS WILL NOT BE ALLOWED TO PARTICIPATE.** Please check out all the tabs for additional important information.

items.name: Welcome to Bishkek 2024
items.information: Русский Welcome to Bishkek 2024 - это открытый чемпионат по скоростной сборке головоломок в городе Бишкек. Регистрационный взнос составляет 900 сом Кыргызча. Welcome to Bishkek 2024 — Бишкек шаарында өтүүчү пазлдарды жогорку ылдамдыкта чогултуу боюнча ачык чемпионат. Катышууга үчүн төлөм 900 сомду түзөт. English Summer in Bishkek 2024 is an open championship in high-speed puzzle assembly in the city of Bishkek. Registration fee is 900 Kyrgyzstani soms
